purpose: This silver table provides cleaned, consistently typed online retail transaction line items (invoice, product, quantity, price, customer, and country) to support downstream sales, returns, and customer analytics.
usage: Consumers should treat the (invoice, stockcode) pair as the working grain for a line item, join on customer_id for customer-level analysis while explicitly filtering or handling the roughly 29.8% of rows where customer_id is null, and rely on invoicedate as a true TIMESTAMP and price as a DECIMAL(10,2) currency amount; negative quantity values represent returns or cancellations and must be interpreted accordingly rather than discarded.
limitations: customer_id is null for about 29.78% of rows (13468 of 45228), representing unidentified or guest transactions that are retained rather than imputed; description is null for about 0.50% of rows (228 of 45228); approximately 1.12% of bronze rows are exact duplicates per the profiled duplicate_row_rate and are removed during cleanup, so downstream counts will differ slightly from bronze; the declared (invoice, stockcode) grain has not been measured against the full warehouse and may need revision by a reviewer if repeated product lines within an invoice are found.
